in_marathi.name: Panneer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Jaggery
in_marathi.long_meaning: Panneer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘panas’ meaning ‘jaggery’, this name symbolizes strength, stability, and sweetness. In Hindu mythology, Panneer is associated with Lord Murugan, who is often depicted holding a spear made of jaggery.
